name: agile-mods
description: Claude Mods for the agile-skills loop: /agile-board opens the agile console pane (board with burndown, ticket and PR flow, drain passes with cost, guards and receipts, links), with a status-line entry and an alert row above the prompt; guards that enforce agent tool grants, the 3f merge gates (pinned reviewed head, fresh green CI) and no push to main or force push inside the loop; /receipts checks agent receipts against the contract; retro counts for agile-15. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later.

autoOpen.title: Open the console when a drain starts
autoOpen.description: Opens the agile console pane, unfocused, when agile-sprint-drain starts. It appears only in a terminal at least 144 columns wide; /agile-board opens it at any width.
